#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare a PCIe generation workspace and invoke ramgen."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import shutil
import sys
import stat
from pathlib import Path

from ramgen import ramgen
from module_append_utils import append_port, append_pin


# Configuration constants
SOURCE_DIR_NAMES = ("examples", "src", "scratch")
ENCODING = "utf-8"

# Directory names
SRC_DIR = "src"
EXAMPLES_DIR = "examples"
SCRATCH_DIR = "scratch"
MEM_DIR = "mem"

# File names
DWC_PCIE_CTL_LST = "DWC_pcie_ctl.lst"
COMPILE_F = "compile.f"
PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV = "pcie_iip_device.sv"
PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_PHY_SV = "pcie_iip_device_phy_block.sv"
PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV = "pcie_iip_subsystem.sv"
PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV = "pcie_iip_rams.sv"
FLIST_F = "flist.f"
DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_V = "DWC_pcie_ctl-undef.v"
RAMS_COMPILE_F = "rams/compile.f"
DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_SVH = "DWC_pcie_ctl_undef.svh"
DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNPREFIX_SVH = "DWC_pcie_ctl_unprefix.svh"
CDM_PL_REG_SV = "Cdm/cdm_pl_reg.sv"
CDM_SV = "Cdm/cdm.sv"
DWC_PCIE_CORE_SV = "products/DWC_pcie_core.sv"

# Module pattern
DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN = "DWC_pcie_ctl"

# CDM signals to add across cdm_pl_reg.sv, cdm.sv, and DWC_pcie_core.sv
CDM_SIGNALS = [
    {"name": "sys_fast_link_mode", "direction": "input"},
    {"name": "sys_link_capable", "direction": "input", "width": "[5:0]"},
]
CDM_PINS = [
    ("sys_fast_link_mode", "sys_fast_link_mode"),
    ("sys_link_capable", "sys_link_capable"),
]


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def read_file_lines(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Read file and return lines."""
    return read_file_text(path).splitlines()


def write_file_lines(path: Path, lines: list[str]) -> None:
    """Write lines to file."""
    write_file_text(path, "\n".join(lines))


def build_module_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    """Build module name prefix from detected prefix string."""
    return f"{prefix}_" if prefix else ""


def build_paths() -> dict:
    """Resolve all runtime paths from the current working directory."""
    project_root = Path.cwd()
    rtl_dir = project_root / "rtl"
    mem_dir = rtl_dir / "mem"
    default_sv_file = project_root / "examples" / "pcie_iip_rams.sv"
    return {
        "project_root": project_root,
        "rtl_dir": rtl_dir,
        "mem_dir": mem_dir,
        "default_sv_file": default_sv_file,
    }


def ensure_source_dirs(project_root: Path, required_dirs: tuple[str, ...]):
    """Validate required source directories before copying."""
    missing = [name for name in required_dirs if not (project_root / name).is_dir()]
    if missing:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "missing required directories under {}: {}".format(
                project_root,
                ", ".join(missing),
            )
        )


def ensure_tree_user_writable(root_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Best-effort set user writable bits for an existing tree."""
    if not root_dir.exists():
        return

    for path in sorted(root_dir.rglob("*")):
        mode = path.stat().st_mode
        if path.is_dir():
            path.chmod(mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR | stat.S_IXUSR)
        else:
            path.chmod(mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR)

    root_mode = root_dir.stat().st_mode
    root_dir.chmod(root_mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR | stat.S_IXUSR)


def copy_tree_into_rtl(project_root: Path, rtl_dir: Path, source_name: str) -> Path:
    """Copy one project directory into rtl/<source_name>."""
    source_dir = project_root / source_name
    destination_dir = rtl_dir / source_name
    
    # Ensure destination is writable before copying
    if destination_dir.exists():
        ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)
    
    shutil.copytree(source_dir, destination_dir, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    
    # Ensure copied files are writable (source may have been read-only)
    ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)
    
    return destination_dir


def copy_scratch_svh_into_rtl(project_root: Path, rtl_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """Copy only .svh files from scratch into rtl/scratch, preserving layout."""
    source_dir = project_root / "scratch"
    destination_dir = rtl_dir / "scratch"
    destination_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    for source_file in source_dir.rglob("*.svh"):
        relative_path = source_file.relative_to(source_dir)
        destination_file = destination_dir / relative_path
        destination_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source_file, destination_file)
    
    # Ensure copied files are writable
    ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)

    return destination_dir


def rewrite_cdm_pl_reg_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/src/Cdm/cdm_pl_reg.sv with new signal definitions."""
    cdm_pl_reg_file = rtl_dir / SRC_DIR / CDM_PL_REG_SV
    if not cdm_pl_reg_file.is_file():
        return None

    lines = read_file_lines(cdm_pl_reg_file)
    rewritten_lines = []
    
    # Replace write_pulse...pl_reg_167 with sys_fast_link_mode and write_pulse...pl_reg_18[5:0] with sys_link_capable
    # Replace matched substrings within lines
    for line in lines:
        line = re.sub(r"\(write_pulse.*pl_reg_16\[7\];", "sys_fast_link_mode;", line)
        line = re.sub(r"\(phy_type.*pl_reg_18\[5:0\];", "sys_link_capable;", line)
        rewritten_lines.append(line)

    write_file_lines(cdm_pl_reg_file, rewritten_lines)
    append_port(cdm_pl_reg_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=False)
    return cdm_pl_reg_file


def rewrite_cdm_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/src/Cdm/cdm.sv to add new port connections and signal declarations."""
    cdm_file = rtl_dir / SRC_DIR / CDM_SV
    if not cdm_file.is_file():
        return None

    append_port(cdm_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=False)
    append_pin(cdm_file, "u_cdm_pl_reg", CDM_PINS)
    return cdm_file


def rewrite_dwc_pcie_core_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/src/products/DWC_pcie_core.sv to add new port connections."""
    dwc_pcie_core_file = rtl_dir / SRC_DIR / DWC_PCIE_CORE_SV
    if not dwc_pcie_core_file.is_file():
        return None

    append_port(dwc_pcie_core_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=True)
    append_pin(dwc_pcie_core_file, "u_cdm", CDM_PINS)
    return dwc_pcie_core_file


def append_cdm_to_dwc_pcie_ctl_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Append CDM ports and u_DWC_pcie_core pins to DWC_pcie_ctl.sv."""
    candidates = sorted((rtl_dir / SRC_DIR).rglob(f"*{DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN}.sv"))
    if not candidates:
        return None
    ctl_file = candidates[0]
    append_port(ctl_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=True)
    append_pin(ctl_file, "u_DWC_pcie_core", CDM_PINS)
    return ctl_file


def append_cdm_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Append CDM ports and u_pcie_core pins to pcie_iip_subsystem.sv."""
    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None
    append_port(subsystem_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=True)
    append_pin(subsystem_file, "u_pcie_core", CDM_PINS)
    return subsystem_file


def append_cdm_to_device_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Append CDM ports and u_subsystem pins to pcie_iip_device.sv."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None
    append_port(device_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=True)
    append_pin(device_file, "u_subsystem", CDM_PINS)
    return device_file


def rewrite_dwc_pcie_ctl_list(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Normalize rtl/src/DWC_pcie_ctl.lst paths and comment out undef include."""
    list_file = rtl_dir / SRC_DIR / DWC_PCIE_CTL_LST
    if not list_file.is_file():
        return None

    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(list_file):
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^.*?src/", "", original_line)
        normalized_line = updated_line.strip()
        if normalized_line.endswith(DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_V):
            rewritten_lines.append(f"// {DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_V}")
            continue
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(list_file, rewritten_lines)
    return list_file


def rewrite_examples_compile_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Normalize rtl/examples/compile.f paths and comment out selected entries."""
    compile_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / COMPILE_F
    if not compile_file.is_file():
        return None

    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(compile_file):
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^.*?examples/", "", original_line)
        normalized_line = updated_line.strip()
        if normalized_line == RAMS_COMPILE_F:
            rewritten_lines.append(f"// {RAMS_COMPILE_F}")
            continue
        if normalized_line == PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV:
            rewritten_lines.append(f"// {PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV}")
            continue
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(compile_file, rewritten_lines)
    return compile_file


def find_module_prefix(rtl_dir: Path) -> str:
    """Infer the module prefix from a module name containing DWC_pcie_ctl."""
    candidate_files = sorted(rtl_dir.rglob(f"*{DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN}.sv"))
    module_pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*module\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\b")

    for candidate_file in candidate_files:
        for line in read_file_lines(candidate_file):
            match = module_pattern.match(line)
            if not match:
                continue
            module_name = match.group(1)
            if DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN not in module_name:
                continue
            raw_prefix = module_name.replace(DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN, "", 1)
            return raw_prefix.rstrip("_")

    raise FileNotFoundError(f"unable to locate a module declaration containing {DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN} under {rtl_dir}")


def rewrite_pcie_iip_device_file(rtl_dir: Path, module_prefix: str) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv with generated module names."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    module_name_prefix = build_module_prefix(module_prefix)
    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(device_file):
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^.*pcie_iip_rams", f"{module_name_prefix}pcie_ram", original_line)
        updated_line = updated_line.replace("`SNPS_PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_MODULE", f"{module_name_prefix}pcie_ctrl")
        updated_line = updated_line.replace(
            "SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
        )
        updated_line = updated_line.replace("(phy_cfg_status)", "('0)")
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(device_file, rewritten_lines)
    return device_file


def _find_phy_block_bounds(lines: list[str]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Find start and end line indices for PHY block section."""
    start_idx = None
    end_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        if start_idx is None and "PHY block instantiation" in line:
            start_idx = idx
        if "include the PHY specific instance code" in line:
            end_idx = idx
    
    if start_idx is None or end_idx is None:
        raise ValueError("unable to locate PHY extraction markers")
    if end_idx < start_idx:
        raise ValueError("invalid PHY extraction marker range")
    
    return start_idx, end_idx


def _extract_and_cut_phy_block(lines: list[str], start_idx: int, end_idx: int) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Extract PHY block and return extracted lines and remaining lines."""
    extract_start = max(0, start_idx - 1)
    extract_end = min(len(lines) - 1, end_idx + 2)
    extracted = list(lines[extract_start : extract_end + 1])
    retained = lines[:extract_start] + lines[extract_end + 1 :]
    return extracted, retained


def _transform_phy_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Apply transformations to PHY block lines."""
    # Replace semicolons with commas
    rewritten = [line.replace(";", ",") for line in lines]
    
    # Cut at PHY_VPT_NUM
    cutoff_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(rewritten):
        if "PHY_VPT_NUM" in line:
            cutoff_idx = idx
            break
    if cutoff_idx is not None:
        rewritten = rewritten[:cutoff_idx]
    
    # Apply wire direction swaps for specific signals
    final_lines = []
    for line in rewritten:
        if any(sig in line for sig in ["pclkx2", "cfg_phy_control", "phy_cfg_status"]):
            continue
        if "pclk" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "input", line)
        if "phy_rst_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "output", line)
        if "phy_perst_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "output", line)
        if "phy_ref_clk_req_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "input", line)
        if "mac_phy" in line:
            line = line.replace("wire", "output")
        if "phy_mac" in line:
            line = line.replace("wire", "input")
        final_lines.append(line)
    
    return final_lines


def _clean_port_list(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Clean port list formatting."""
    # Remove leading commas and consolidate
    cleaned = []
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            cleaned.append(line)
            continue
        content = re.sub(r"^\s*,\s*", "", line)
        cleaned.append(content)
    
    # Remove trailing comma from last non-empty line
    last_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(cleaned):
        if line.strip():
            last_idx = idx
    if last_idx is not None:
        cleaned[last_idx] = re.sub(r",\s*$", "", cleaned[last_idx])
    
    # Add leading comma line
    first_nonempty = next((line for line in cleaned if line.strip()), None)
    if first_nonempty is not None:
        indent = first_nonempty[: len(first_nonempty) - len(first_nonempty.lstrip())]
        cleaned = [f"{indent},"] + cleaned
    
    return cleaned


def _merge_phy_into_module(retained_lines: list[str], phy_lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Merge PHY port lines into module port list."""
    module_start = None
    port_list_end = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(retained_lines):
        if module_start is None and re.search(r"\bmodule\b", line):
            module_start = idx
        if module_start is not None and line.strip() == ");":
            port_list_end = idx
            break
    
    if module_start is None or port_list_end is None:
        raise ValueError("unable to locate module port list")
    
    # Remove RF signal ports
    remove_pattern = re.compile(r"\b(rxp|rxn|txp|txn|rxpresent|refclk_p|refclk_n)\b")
    port_lines = retained_lines[module_start + 1 : port_list_end]
    filtered_ports = [line for line in port_lines if not remove_pattern.search(line)]
    
    merged = (
        retained_lines[: module_start + 1]
        + filtered_ports
        + phy_lines
        + retained_lines[port_list_end:]
    )
    return merged


def extract_phy_block_from_device_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Extract and rewrite the PHY block section from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    output_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_PHY_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    lines = read_file_lines(device_file)
    
    # Find and extract PHY block
    start_idx, end_idx = _find_phy_block_bounds(lines)
    extracted_lines, retained_lines = _extract_and_cut_phy_block(lines, start_idx, end_idx)
    
    # Transform and clean PHY lines
    phy_lines = _transform_phy_lines(extracted_lines)
    phy_lines = _clean_port_list(phy_lines)
    
    # Merge back into module port list
    merged_lines = _merge_phy_into_module(retained_lines, phy_lines)
    
    # Write output files
    write_file_lines(device_file, merged_lines)
    write_file_lines(output_file, phy_lines)
    return output_file


def rewrite_pcie_iip_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, module_prefix: str) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/examples/pcie_iip_subsystem.sv with prefixed module macros."""
    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    module_name_prefix = build_module_prefix(module_prefix)
    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(subsystem_file):
        updated_line = original_line.replace(
            "SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
        )
        updated_line = updated_line.replace(
            "SNPS_PCIE_CTL_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}SNPS_PCIE_CTL_MODULE",
        )
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(subsystem_file, rewritten_lines)
    return subsystem_file


def extract_pcie_ram_port_from_rams_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> str | None:
    """Extract and transform input/output port declarations from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_rams.sv."""
    rams_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV
    if not rams_file.is_file():
        return None

    transformed_lines: list[str] = []
    for line in read_file_lines(rams_file):
        if not re.match(r"^\s*(input|output)\b", line):
            continue
        if re.match(r"^\s*input\b.*clk", line):
            continue
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^(\s*)(input|output)\b", r"\1wire", line)
        updated_line = re.sub(r",\s*$", "", updated_line.rstrip())
        if not updated_line.endswith(";"):
            updated_line += ";"
        transformed_lines.append(updated_line)

    if not transformed_lines:
        return None
    return "\n".join(transformed_lines)


def append_pcie_ram_port_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, pcie_ram_port: str | None) -> Path | None:
    """Append extracted pcie_ram_port block after the first ');' in subsystem file."""
    if not pcie_ram_port:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(subsystem_file)
    if pcie_ram_port in text:
        return subsystem_file

    close_ports_match = re.search(r"^\s*\);\s*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
    if not close_ports_match:
        return None

    insert_pos = close_ports_match.end()
    if text[insert_pos:insert_pos + 2] == "\r\n":
        insert_pos += 2
    elif text[insert_pos:insert_pos + 1] == "\n":
        insert_pos += 1

    new_text = text[:insert_pos] + pcie_ram_port.rstrip("\n") + "\n" + text[insert_pos:]
    write_file_text(subsystem_file, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return subsystem_file


def extract_signal_names_from_pcie_ram_port(pcie_ram_port: str | None) -> list[str]:
    """Extract signal names from transformed pcie_ram_port declarations."""
    if not pcie_ram_port:
        return []

    signal_names: list[str] = []
    for line in pcie_ram_port.splitlines():
        match = re.match(r"^\s*(?:wire|input|output)\b(?:\s+\[[^\]]+\])?\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*;", line)
        if match:
            signal_names.append(match.group(1))
    return signal_names


def delete_pcie_ram_signal_lines_from_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, signal_names: list[str]) -> Path | None:
    """Delete lines containing any pcie ram signal name from subsystem file."""
    if not signal_names:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    patterns = [re.compile(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b") for name in signal_names]
    original_lines = read_file_lines(subsystem_file)
    kept_lines = [line for line in original_lines if not any(pattern.search(line) for pattern in patterns)]
    if kept_lines == original_lines:
        return subsystem_file

    write_file_lines(subsystem_file, kept_lines)
    return subsystem_file


def extract_pcie_ram_inst_from_device_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> str | None:
    """Extract external_rams instance block from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(device_file)
    # Match by instance name `external_rams` so module type can be prefixed/renamed.
    match = re.search(
        r"(^\s*[`A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$`]*\s*(?:#\s*\([\s\S]*?\)\s*)?external_rams\s*\([\s\S]*?\)\s*;)",
        text,
        re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if not match:
        return None
    return match.group(1).rstrip()


def append_pcie_ram_inst_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, pcie_ram_inst: str | None) -> Path | None:
    """Append extracted pcie_ram_inst block before endmodule in subsystem file."""
    if not pcie_ram_inst:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(subsystem_file)
    if pcie_ram_inst in text:
        return subsystem_file

    endmodule_match = re.search(r"^\s*endmodule\b", text, re.MULTILINE)
    if not endmodule_match:
        return None

    insert_pos = endmodule_match.start()
    prefix = text[:insert_pos].rstrip("\n")
    suffix = text[insert_pos:]
    new_text = f"{prefix}\n{pcie_ram_inst}\n{suffix}"
    write_file_text(subsystem_file, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return subsystem_file


def write_rtl_flist(rtl_dir: Path, include_scratch: bool) -> Path:
    """Write rtl/flist.f using the required line-by-line layout."""
    flist_file = rtl_dir / FLIST_F
    lines = [
        f"+incdir+{SRC_DIR}",
        f"-F {SRC_DIR}/{DWC_PCIE_CTL_LST}",
        f"-F {MEM_DIR}/{FLIST_F}",
        f"-F {EXAMPLES_DIR}/{COMPILE_F}",
    ]
    if include_scratch:
        lines.insert(3, DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNPREFIX_SVH)
        lines.append(DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_SVH)
    write_file_lines(flist_file, lines)
    return flist_file


def validate_ramgen_outputs(result: dict) -> None:
    """Ensure ramgen returned the expected output files."""
    expected_paths = [
        result.get("excel_path"),
        result.get("raminfo_csv_path"),
        result.get("output_sv_path"),
        result.get("flist_path"),
        result.get("tb_flist_path"),
        result.get("makefile_path"),
    ]
    missing = [path for path in expected_paths if not path or not Path(path).exists()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("ramgen completed but expected outputs are missing: {}".format(", ".join(missing)))


def run() -> dict:
    """Create rtl workspace content and run ramgen."""
    total_steps = 8

    def log_step(step_no: int, message: str) -> None:
        print("[{}/{}] {} ... ".format(step_no, total_steps, message), end="", flush=True)

    def log_ok() -> None:
        print("OK", flush=True)

    log_step(1, "validate inputs")
    paths = build_paths()
    project_root = paths["project_root"]
    rtl_dir = paths["rtl_dir"]
    mem_dir = paths["mem_dir"]
    default_sv_file = paths["default_sv_file"]
    rtl_sv_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV

    ensure_source_dirs(project_root, ("examples", "src"))
    if not default_sv_file.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing input SV file: {default_sv_file}")
    log_ok()

    log_step(2, "prepare rtl workspace")
    rtl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    mem_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_ok()

    log_step(3, "copy examples and src")
    copied_dirs = {}
    for source_name in ("examples", "src"):
        copied_dirs[source_name] = str(copy_tree_into_rtl(project_root, rtl_dir, source_name))

    if not rtl_sv_file.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing copied input SV file: {rtl_sv_file}")
    log_ok()

    log_step(4, "detect module prefix")
    module_prefix = find_module_prefix(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    log_step(5, "copy scratch if needed")
    copied_scratch = False
    rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file = None
    rewritten_cdm_file = None
    rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file = None
    if module_prefix:
        ensure_source_dirs(project_root, ("scratch",))
        copied_dirs["scratch"] = str(copy_scratch_svh_into_rtl(project_root, rtl_dir))
        copied_scratch = True
        rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file = rewrite_cdm_pl_reg_file(rtl_dir)
        rewritten_cdm_file = rewrite_cdm_file(rtl_dir)
        rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file = rewrite_dwc_pcie_core_file(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    log_step(6, "rewrite rtl files")
    rewritten_list_file = rewrite_dwc_pcie_ctl_list(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_compile_file = rewrite_examples_compile_file(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_device_file = rewrite_pcie_iip_device_file(rtl_dir, module_prefix)
    pcie_ram_port = extract_pcie_ram_port_from_rams_file(rtl_dir)
    pcie_ram_inst = extract_pcie_ram_inst_from_device_file(rtl_dir)
    extracted_phy_block_file = extract_phy_block_from_device_file(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_subsystem_file = rewrite_pcie_iip_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, module_prefix)
    pcie_ram_signal_names = extract_signal_names_from_pcie_ram_port(pcie_ram_port)
    deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file = delete_pcie_ram_signal_lines_from_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, pcie_ram_signal_names)
    appended_pcie_ram_port_file = append_pcie_ram_port_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, pcie_ram_port)
    appended_pcie_ram_inst_file = append_pcie_ram_inst_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, pcie_ram_inst)
    log_ok()

    log_step(7, "run ramgen and generate flist")
    ramgen_result = ramgen(
        sv_file=str(rtl_sv_file),
        output_dir=str(mem_dir),
        module_prefix=module_prefix,
        verbose=False,
    )
    validate_ramgen_outputs(ramgen_result)
    rtl_flist_file = write_rtl_flist(rtl_dir, include_scratch=copied_scratch)
    log_ok()

    log_step(8, "append CDM signals and pins")
    rewrite_cdm_pl_reg_file(rtl_dir)
    rewrite_cdm_file(rtl_dir)
    rewrite_dwc_pcie_core_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_dwc_pcie_ctl_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_device_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    return {
        "project_root": str(project_root),
        "rtl_dir": str(rtl_dir),
        "mem_dir": str(mem_dir),
        "copied_dirs": copied_dirs,
        "module_prefix": module_prefix,
        "rewritten_list_file": str(rewritten_list_file) if rewritten_list_file else None,
        "rewritten_compile_file": str(rewritten_compile_file) if rewritten_compile_file else None,
        "rewritten_device_file": str(rewritten_device_file) if rewritten_device_file else None,
        "deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file": str(deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file) if deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file else None,
        "appended_pcie_ram_port_file": str(appended_pcie_ram_port_file) if appended_pcie_ram_port_file else None,
        "appended_pcie_ram_inst_file": str(appended_pcie_ram_inst_file) if appended_pcie_ram_inst_file else None,
        "extracted_phy_block_file": str(extracted_phy_block_file) if extracted_phy_block_file else None,
        "rewritten_subsystem_file": str(rewritten_subsystem_file) if rewritten_subsystem_file else None,
        "rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file": str(rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file) if rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file else None,
        "rewritten_cdm_file": str(rewritten_cdm_file) if rewritten_cdm_file else None,
        "rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file": str(rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file) if rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file else None,
        "rtl_flist_file": str(rtl_flist_file),
        "ramgen": ramgen_result,
    }


def main() -> int:
    """CLI entry point."""
    try:
        result = run()
    except PermissionError as exc:
        print(f"Error: permission denied: {exc}\ntip: work in a directory you own with write permission", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    # Print execution summary
    print(f"✓ Prepared RTL workspace: {result['rtl_dir']}")
    print(f"✓ Generated RAM outputs: {result['mem_dir']}")
    module_prefix = result["module_prefix"] if result["module_prefix"] else "(none)"
    print(f"✓ Detected module prefix: {module_prefix}")
    print(f"✓ Generated flist: {result['rtl_flist_file']}")
    
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import shutil
import sys

from pathlib import Path

from ramgen import ramgen
from module_append_utils import append_port, append_pin


# Configuration constants
SOURCE_DIR_NAMES = ("examples", "src", "scratch")
ENCODING = "utf-8"

DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNPREFIX_SVH = "DWC_pcie_ctl_unprefix.svh"

CDM_SV = "Cdm/cdm.sv"
DWC_PCIE_CORE_SV = "products/DWC_pcie_core.sv"

]
CDM_PINS = [
    ("sys_fast_link_mode", "sys_fast_link_mode"),
    ("sys_link_capable", "sys_link_capable"),
]


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def read_file_lines(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Read file and return lines."""
    return read_file_text(path).splitlines()


def write_file_lines(path: Path, lines: list[str]) -> None:
    """Write lines to file."""
    write_file_text(path, "\n".join(lines))


def build_module_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    """Build module name prefix from detected prefix string."""
    return f"{prefix}_" if prefix else ""


def build_paths() -> dict:
    """Resolve all runtime paths from the current working directory."""
    project_root = Path.cwd()
    rtl_dir = project_root / "rtl"
    mem_dir = rtl_dir / "mem"
    default_sv_file = project_root / "examples" / "pcie_iip_rams.sv"
    return {
        "project_root": project_root,
        "rtl_dir": rtl_dir,
        "mem_dir": mem_dir,
        "default_sv_file": default_sv_file,
    }


def ensure_source_dirs(project_root: Path, required_dirs: tuple[str, ...]):
    """Validate required source directories before copying."""
    missing = [name for name in required_dirs if not (project_root / name).is_dir()]
    if missing:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "missing required directories under {}: {}".format(
                project_root,
                ", ".join(missing),
            )
        )


def ensure_tree_user_writable(root_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Best-effort set user writable bits for an existing tree."""
    if not root_dir.exists():
        return

    for path in sorted(root_dir.rglob("*")):
        mode = path.stat().st_mode
        if path.is_dir():
            path.chmod(mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR | stat.S_IXUSR)
        else:
            path.chmod(mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR)

    root_mode = root_dir.stat().st_mode
    root_dir.chmod(root_mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR | stat.S_IXUSR)


def copy_tree_into_rtl(project_root: Path, rtl_dir: Path, source_name: str) -> Path:
    """Copy one project directory into rtl/<source_name>."""
    source_dir = project_root / source_name
    destination_dir = rtl_dir / source_name
    
    # Ensure destination is writable before copying
    if destination_dir.exists():
        ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)
    
    shutil.copytree(source_dir, destination_dir, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    
    # Ensure copied files are writable (source may have been read-only)
    ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)
    
    return destination_dir


def copy_scratch_svh_into_rtl(project_root: Path, rtl_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """Copy only .svh files from scratch into rtl/scratch, preserving layout."""
    source_dir = project_root / "scratch"
    destination_dir = rtl_dir / "scratch"
    destination_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    for source_file in source_dir.rglob("*.svh"):
        relative_path = source_file.relative_to(source_dir)
        destination_file = destination_dir / relative_path
        destination_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source_file, destination_file)
    
    # Ensure copied files are writable
    ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)

    return destination_dir

    """Rewrite rtl/src/Cdm/cdm_pl_reg.sv with new signal definitions."""

def find_module_prefix(rtl_dir: Path) -> str:
    """Infer the module prefix from a module name containing DWC_pcie_ctl."""
    candidate_files = sorted(rtl_dir.rglob(f"*{DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN}.sv"))
    module_pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*module\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\b")

def rewrite_pcie_iip_device_file(rtl_dir: Path, module_prefix: str) -> Path | None:

def _find_phy_block_bounds(lines: list[str]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Find start and end line indices for PHY block section."""
    start_idx = None
    end_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        if start_idx is None and "PHY block instantiation" in line:
            start_idx = idx
        if "include the PHY specific instance code" in line:
            end_idx = idx
    
    if start_idx is None or end_idx is None:
        raise ValueError("unable to locate PHY extraction markers")
    if end_idx < start_idx:
        raise ValueError("invalid PHY extraction marker range")
    
    return start_idx, end_idx


def _extract_and_cut_phy_block(lines: list[str], start_idx: int, end_idx: int) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Extract PHY block and return extracted lines and remaining lines."""
    extract_start = max(0, start_idx - 1)
    extract_end = min(len(lines) - 1, end_idx + 2)
    extracted = list(lines[extract_start : extract_end + 1])
    retained = lines[:extract_start] + lines[extract_end + 1 :]
    return extracted, retained


def _transform_phy_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Apply transformations to PHY block lines."""
    # Replace semicolons with commas
    rewritten = [line.replace(";", ",") for line in lines]
    
    # Cut at PHY_VPT_NUM
    cutoff_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(rewritten):
        if "PHY_VPT_NUM" in line:
            cutoff_idx = idx
            break
    if cutoff_idx is not None:
        rewritten = rewritten[:cutoff_idx]
    
    # Apply wire direction swaps for specific signals
    final_lines = []
    for line in rewritten:
        if any(sig in line for sig in ["pclkx2", "cfg_phy_control", "phy_cfg_status"]):
            continue
        if "pclk" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "input", line)
        if "phy_rst_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "output", line)
        if "phy_perst_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "output", line)
        if "phy_ref_clk_req_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "input", line)
        if "mac_phy" in line:
            line = line.replace("wire", "output")
        if "phy_mac" in line:
            line = line.replace("wire", "input")
        final_lines.append(line)
    
    return final_lines


def _clean_port_list(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Clean port list formatting."""
    # Remove leading commas and consolidate
    cleaned = []
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            cleaned.append(line)
            continue
        content = re.sub(r"^\s*,\s*", "", line)
        cleaned.append(content)
    
    # Remove trailing comma from last non-empty line
    last_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(cleaned):
        if line.strip():
            last_idx = idx
    if last_idx is not None:
        cleaned[last_idx] = re.sub(r",\s*$", "", cleaned[last_idx])
    
    # Add leading comma line
    first_nonempty = next((line for line in cleaned if line.strip()), None)
    if first_nonempty is not None:
        indent = first_nonempty[: len(first_nonempty) - len(first_nonempty.lstrip())]
        cleaned = [f"{indent},"] + cleaned
    
    return cleaned


def _merge_phy_into_module(retained_lines: list[str], phy_lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Merge PHY port lines into module port list."""
    module_start = None
    port_list_end = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(retained_lines):
        if module_start is None and re.search(r"\bmodule\b", line):
            module_start = idx
        if module_start is not None and line.strip() == ");":
            port_list_end = idx
            break
    
    if module_start is None or port_list_end is None:
        raise ValueError("unable to locate module port list")
    
    # Remove RF signal ports
    remove_pattern = re.compile(r"\b(rxp|rxn|txp|txn|rxpresent|refclk_p|refclk_n)\b")
    port_lines = retained_lines[module_start + 1 : port_list_end]
    filtered_ports = [line for line in port_lines if not remove_pattern.search(line)]
    
    merged = (
        retained_lines[: module_start + 1]
        + filtered_ports
        + phy_lines
        + retained_lines[port_list_end:]
    )
    return merged


def extract_phy_block_from_device_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Extract and rewrite the PHY block section from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    output_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_PHY_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    lines = read_file_lines(device_file)
    
    # Find and extract PHY block
    start_idx, end_idx = _find_phy_block_bounds(lines)
    extracted_lines, retained_lines = _extract_and_cut_phy_block(lines, start_idx, end_idx)
    
    # Transform and clean PHY lines
    phy_lines = _transform_phy_lines(extracted_lines)
    phy_lines = _clean_port_list(phy_lines)
    
    # Merge back into module port list
    merged_lines = _merge_phy_into_module(retained_lines, phy_lines)
    
    # Write output files
    write_file_lines(device_file, merged_lines)
    write_file_lines(output_file, phy_lines)
    return output_file


def rewrite_pcie_iip_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, module_prefix: str) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/examples/pcie_iip_subsystem.sv with prefixed module macros."""
    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    module_name_prefix = build_module_prefix(module_prefix)
    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(subsystem_file):
        updated_line = original_line.replace(
            "`SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}pcie_ctrl",
        )
        updated_line = updated_line.replace(
            "SNPS_PCIE_CTL_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}SNPS_PCIE_CTL_MODULE",
        )
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(subsystem_file, rewritten_lines)
    return subsystem_file


def extract_pcie_ram_port_from_rams_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> str | None:
    """Extract and transform input/output port declarations from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_rams.sv."""
    rams_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV
    if not rams_file.is_file():
        return None

    transformed_lines: list[str] = []
    for line in read_file_lines(rams_file):
        if not re.match(r"^\s*(input|output)\b", line):
            continue
        if re.match(r"^\s*input\b.*clk", line):
            continue
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^(\s*)(input|output)\b", r"\1wire", line)
        updated_line = re.sub(r",\s*$", "", updated_line.rstrip())
        if not updated_line.endswith(";"):
            updated_line += ";"
        transformed_lines.append(updated_line)

    if not transformed_lines:
        return None
    return "\n".join(transformed_lines)


def append_pcie_ram_port_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, pcie_ram_port: str | None) -> Path | None:
    """Append extracted pcie_ram_port block after the first ');' in subsystem file."""
    if not pcie_ram_port:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(subsystem_file)
    if pcie_ram_port in text:
        return subsystem_file

    close_ports_match = re.search(r"^\s*\);\s*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
    if not close_ports_match:
        return None

    insert_pos = close_ports_match.end()
    if text[insert_pos:insert_pos + 2] == "\r\n":
        insert_pos += 2
    elif text[insert_pos:insert_pos + 1] == "\n":
        insert_pos += 1

    new_text = text[:insert_pos] + pcie_ram_port.rstrip("\n") + "\n" + text[insert_pos:]
    write_file_text(subsystem_file, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return subsystem_file


def extract_signal_names_from_pcie_ram_port(pcie_ram_port: str | None) -> list[str]:
    """Extract signal names from transformed pcie_ram_port declarations."""
    if not pcie_ram_port:
        return []

    signal_names: list[str] = []
    for line in pcie_ram_port.splitlines():
        match = re.match(r"^\s*(?:wire|input|output)\b(?:\s+\[[^\]]+\])?\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*;", line)
        if match:
            signal_names.append(match.group(1))
    return signal_names


def delete_pcie_ram_signal_lines_from_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, signal_names: list[str]) -> Path | None:
    """Delete lines containing any pcie ram signal name from subsystem file."""
    if not signal_names:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    patterns = [re.compile(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b") for name in signal_names]
    original_lines = read_file_lines(subsystem_file)
    kept_lines = [line for line in original_lines if not any(pattern.search(line) for pattern in patterns)]
    if kept_lines == original_lines:
        return subsystem_file

    write_file_lines(subsystem_file, kept_lines)
    return subsystem_file


def extract_pcie_ram_inst_from_device_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> str | None:
    """Extract external_rams instance block from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(device_file)
    # Match by instance name `external_rams` so module type can be prefixed/renamed.
    match = re.search(
        r"(^\s*[`A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$`]*\s*(?:#\s*\([\s\S]*?\)\s*)?external_rams\s*\([\s\S]*?\)\s*;)",
        text,
        re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if not match:
        return None
    return match.group(1).rstrip()


def append_pcie_ram_inst_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, pcie_ram_inst: str | None) -> Path | None:
    """Append extracted pcie_ram_inst block before endmodule in subsystem file."""
    if not pcie_ram_inst:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(subsystem_file)
    if pcie_ram_inst in text:
        return subsystem_file

    endmodule_match = re.search(r"^\s*endmodule\b", text, re.MULTILINE)
    if not endmodule_match:
        return None

    insert_pos = endmodule_match.start()
    prefix = text[:insert_pos].rstrip("\n")
    suffix = text[insert_pos:]
    new_text = f"{prefix}\n{pcie_ram_inst}\n{suffix}"
    write_file_text(subsystem_file, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return subsystem_file


def write_rtl_flist(rtl_dir: Path, include_scratch: bool) -> Path:
    """Write rtl/flist.f using the required line-by-line layout."""
    flist_file = rtl_dir / FLIST_F
    lines = [
        f"+incdir+{SRC_DIR}",
        f"-F {SRC_DIR}/{DWC_PCIE_CTL_LST}",
        f"-F {MEM_DIR}/{FLIST_F}",
        f"-F {EXAMPLES_DIR}/{COMPILE_F}",
    ]
    if include_scratch:
        lines.insert(3, DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNPREFIX_SVH)
        lines.append(DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_SVH)
    write_file_lines(flist_file, lines)
    return flist_file


def validate_ramgen_outputs(result: dict) -> None:
    """Ensure ramgen returned the expected output files."""
    expected_paths = [
        result.get("excel_path"),
        result.get("raminfo_csv_path"),
        result.get("output_sv_path"),
        result.get("flist_path"),
        result.get("tb_flist_path"),
        result.get("makefile_path"),
    ]
    missing = [path for path in expected_paths if not path or not Path(path).exists()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("ramgen completed but expected outputs are missing: {}".format(", ".join(missing)))


def run() -> dict:
    """Create rtl workspace content and run ramgen."""
    total_steps = 8

    def log_step(step_no: int, message: str) -> None:
        print("[{}/{}] {} ... ".format(step_no, total_steps, message), end="", flush=True)

    def log_ok() -> None:
        print("OK", flush=True)

    log_step(1, "validate inputs")
    paths = build_paths()
    project_root = paths["project_root"]
    rtl_dir = paths["rtl_dir"]
    mem_dir = paths["mem_dir"]
    default_sv_file = paths["default_sv_file"]
    rtl_sv_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV

    ensure_source_dirs(project_root, ("examples", "src"))
    if not default_sv_file.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing input SV file: {default_sv_file}")
    log_ok()

    log_step(2, "prepare rtl workspace")
    rtl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    mem_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_ok()

    log_step(3, "copy examples and src")
    copied_dirs = {}
    for source_name in ("examples", "src"):
        copied_dirs[source_name] = str(copy_tree_into_rtl(project_root, rtl_dir, source_name))

    if not rtl_sv_file.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing copied input SV file: {rtl_sv_file}")
    log_ok()

    log_step(4, "detect module prefix")
    module_prefix = find_module_prefix(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    log_step(5, "copy scratch if needed")
    copied_scratch = False
    rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file = None
    rewritten_cdm_file = None
    rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file = None
    if module_prefix:
        ensure_source_dirs(project_root, ("scratch",))
        copied_dirs["scratch"] = str(copy_scratch_svh_into_rtl(project_root, rtl_dir))
        copied_scratch = True
        rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file = rewrite_cdm_pl_reg_file(rtl_dir)
        rewritten_cdm_file = rewrite_cdm_file(rtl_dir)
        rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file = rewrite_dwc_pcie_core_file(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    log_step(6, "rewrite rtl files")
    rewritten_list_file = rewrite_dwc_pcie_ctl_list(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_compile_file = rewrite_examples_compile_file(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_device_file = rewrite_pcie_iip_device_file(rtl_dir, module_prefix)
    pcie_ram_port = extract_pcie_ram_port_from_rams_file(rtl_dir)
    pcie_ram_inst = extract_pcie_ram_inst_from_device_file(rtl_dir)
    extracted_phy_block_file = extract_phy_block_from_device_file(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_subsystem_file = rewrite_pcie_iip_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, module_prefix)
    pcie_ram_signal_names = extract_signal_names_from_pcie_ram_port(pcie_ram_port)
    deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file = delete_pcie_ram_signal_lines_from_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, pcie_ram_signal_names)
    appended_pcie_ram_port_file = append_pcie_ram_port_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, pcie_ram_port)
    appended_pcie_ram_inst_file = append_pcie_ram_inst_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, pcie_ram_inst)
    log_ok()

    log_step(7, "run ramgen and generate flist")
    ramgen_result = ramgen(
        sv_file=str(rtl_sv_file),
        output_dir=str(mem_dir),
        module_prefix=module_prefix,
        verbose=False,
    )
    validate_ramgen_outputs(ramgen_result)
    rtl_flist_file = write_rtl_flist(rtl_dir, include_scratch=copied_scratch)
    log_ok()

    log_step(8, "append CDM signals and pins")
    rewrite_cdm_pl_reg_file(rtl_dir)
    rewrite_cdm_file(rtl_dir)
    rewrite_dwc_pcie_core_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_dwc_pcie_ctl_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_device_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    return {
        "project_root": str(project_root),
        "rtl_dir": str(rtl_dir),
        "mem_dir": str(mem_dir),
        "copied_dirs": copied_dirs,
        "module_prefix": module_prefix,
        "rewritten_list_file": str(rewritten_list_file) if rewritten_list_file else None,
        "rewritten_compile_file": str(rewritten_compile_file) if rewritten_compile_file else None,
        "rewritten_device_file": str(rewritten_device_file) if rewritten_device_file else None,
        "deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file": str(deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file) if deleted_pcie_ram_signal_lines_file else None,
        "appended_pcie_ram_port_file": str(appended_pcie_ram_port_file) if appended_pcie_ram_port_file else None,
        "appended_pcie_ram_inst_file": str(appended_pcie_ram_inst_file) if appended_pcie_ram_inst_file else None,
        "extracted_phy_block_file": str(extracted_phy_block_file) if extracted_phy_block_file else None,
        "rewritten_subsystem_file": str(rewritten_subsystem_file) if rewritten_subsystem_file else None,
        "rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file": str(rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file) if rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file else None,
        "rewritten_cdm_file": str(rewritten_cdm_file) if rewritten_cdm_file else None,
        "rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file": str(rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file) if rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file else None,
        "rtl_flist_file": str(rtl_flist_file),
        "ramgen": ramgen_result,
    }


def main() -> int:
    """CLI entry point."""
    try:
        result = run()
    except PermissionError as exc:
        print(f"Error: permission denied: {exc}\ntip: work in a directory you own with write permission", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"Error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    # Print execution summary
    print(f"✓ Prepared RTL workspace: {result['rtl_dir']}")
    print(f"✓ Generated RAM outputs: {result['mem_dir']}")
    module_prefix = result["module_prefix"] if result["module_prefix"] else "(none)"
    print(f"✓ Detected module prefix: {module_prefix}")
    print(f"✓ Generated flist: {result['rtl_flist_file']}")
    
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare a PCIe generation workspace and invoke ramgen."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import shutil
import sys
import stat
from pathlib import Path

from ramgen import ramgen
from module_append_utils import append_port, append_pin


# Configuration constants
SOURCE_DIR_NAMES = ("examples", "src", "scratch")
ENCODING = "utf-8"

# Directory names
SRC_DIR = "src"
EXAMPLES_DIR = "examples"
SCRATCH_DIR = "scratch"
MEM_DIR = "mem"

# File names
DWC_PCIE_CTL_LST = "DWC_pcie_ctl.lst"
COMPILE_F = "compile.f"
PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV = "pcie_iip_device.sv"
PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_PHY_SV = "pcie_iip_device_phy_block.sv"
PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV = "pcie_iip_subsystem.sv"
PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV = "pcie_iip_rams.sv"
FLIST_F = "flist.f"
DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_V = "DWC_pcie_ctl-undef.v"
RAMS_COMPILE_F = "rams/compile.f"
DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_SVH = "DWC_pcie_ctl_undef.svh"
DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNPREFIX_SVH = "DWC_pcie_ctl_unprefix.svh"
CDM_PL_REG_SV = "Cdm/cdm_pl_reg.sv"
CDM_SV = "Cdm/cdm.sv"
DWC_PCIE_CORE_SV = "products/DWC_pcie_core.sv"

# Module pattern
DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN = "DWC_pcie_ctl"

# CDM signals to add across cdm_pl_reg.sv, cdm.sv, and DWC_pcie_core.sv
CDM_SIGNALS = [
    {"name": "sys_fast_link_mode", "direction": "input"},
    {"name": "sys_link_capable", "direction": "input", "width": "[5:0]"},
]
CDM_PINS = [
    ("sys_fast_link_mode", "sys_fast_link_mode"),
    ("sys_link_capable", "sys_link_capable"),
]


def read_file_text(path: Path) -> str:
    """Read file with standard encoding."""
    return path.read_text(encoding=ENCODING)


def write_file_text(path: Path, content: str) -> None:
    """Write file with standard encoding and newline."""
    path.write_text(content + "\n", encoding=ENCODING)


def read_file_lines(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Read file and return lines."""
    return read_file_text(path).splitlines()


def write_file_lines(path: Path, lines: list[str]) -> None:
    """Write lines to file."""
    write_file_text(path, "\n".join(lines))


def build_module_prefix(prefix: str) -> str:
    """Build module name prefix from detected prefix string."""
    return f"{prefix}_" if prefix else ""


def build_paths() -> dict:
    """Resolve all runtime paths from the current working directory."""
    project_root = Path.cwd()
    rtl_dir = project_root / "rtl"
    mem_dir = rtl_dir / "mem"
    default_sv_file = project_root / "examples" / "pcie_iip_rams.sv"
    return {
        "project_root": project_root,
        "rtl_dir": rtl_dir,
        "mem_dir": mem_dir,
        "default_sv_file": default_sv_file,
    }


def ensure_source_dirs(project_root: Path, required_dirs: tuple[str, ...]):
    """Validate required source directories before copying."""
    missing = [name for name in required_dirs if not (project_root / name).is_dir()]
    if missing:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "missing required directories under {}: {}".format(
                project_root,
                ", ".join(missing),
            )
        )


def ensure_tree_user_writable(root_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Best-effort set user writable bits for an existing tree."""
    if not root_dir.exists():
        return

    for path in sorted(root_dir.rglob("*")):
        mode = path.stat().st_mode
        if path.is_dir():
            path.chmod(mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR | stat.S_IXUSR)
        else:
            path.chmod(mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR)

    root_mode = root_dir.stat().st_mode
    root_dir.chmod(root_mode | stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR | stat.S_IXUSR)


def copy_tree_into_rtl(project_root: Path, rtl_dir: Path, source_name: str) -> Path:
    """Copy one project directory into rtl/<source_name>."""
    source_dir = project_root / source_name
    destination_dir = rtl_dir / source_name
    
    # Ensure destination is writable before copying
    if destination_dir.exists():
        ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)
    
    shutil.copytree(source_dir, destination_dir, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    
    # Ensure copied files are writable (source may have been read-only)
    ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)
    
    return destination_dir


def copy_scratch_svh_into_rtl(project_root: Path, rtl_dir: Path) -> Path:
    """Copy only .svh files from scratch into rtl/scratch, preserving layout."""
    source_dir = project_root / "scratch"
    destination_dir = rtl_dir / "scratch"
    destination_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    for source_file in source_dir.rglob("*.svh"):
        relative_path = source_file.relative_to(source_dir)
        destination_file = destination_dir / relative_path
        destination_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source_file, destination_file)
    
    # Ensure copied files are writable
    ensure_tree_user_writable(destination_dir)

    return destination_dir


def rewrite_cdm_pl_reg_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/src/Cdm/cdm_pl_reg.sv with new signal definitions."""
    cdm_pl_reg_file = rtl_dir / SRC_DIR / CDM_PL_REG_SV
    if not cdm_pl_reg_file.is_file():
        return None

    lines = read_file_lines(cdm_pl_reg_file)
    rewritten_lines = []
    
    # Replace write_pulse...pl_reg_167 with sys_fast_link_mode and write_pulse...pl_reg_18[5:0] with sys_link_capable
    # Replace matched substrings within lines
    for line in lines:
        line = re.sub(r"\(write_pulse.*pl_reg_16\[7\];", "sys_fast_link_mode;", line)
        line = re.sub(r"\(phy_type.*pl_reg_18\[5:0\];", "sys_link_capable;", line)
        rewritten_lines.append(line)

    write_file_lines(cdm_pl_reg_file, rewritten_lines)
    append_port(cdm_pl_reg_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=False)
    return cdm_pl_reg_file


def rewrite_cdm_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:

    cdm_file = rtl_dir / SRC_DIR / CDM_SV

    append_port(cdm_file, CDM_SIGNALS, c_like=False)

def rewrite_dwc_pcie_ctl_list(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Normalize rtl/src/DWC_pcie_ctl.lst paths and comment out undef include."""
    list_file = rtl_dir / SRC_DIR / DWC_PCIE_CTL_LST
    if not list_file.is_file():
        return None

    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(list_file):
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^.*?src/", "", original_line)
        normalized_line = updated_line.strip()
        if normalized_line.endswith(DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_V):
            rewritten_lines.append(f"// {DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_V}")
            continue
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(list_file, rewritten_lines)
    return list_file


def rewrite_examples_compile_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Normalize rtl/examples/compile.f paths and comment out selected entries."""
    compile_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / COMPILE_F
    if not compile_file.is_file():
        return None

    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(compile_file):
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^.*?examples/", "", original_line)
        normalized_line = updated_line.strip()
        if normalized_line == RAMS_COMPILE_F:
            rewritten_lines.append(f"// {RAMS_COMPILE_F}")
            continue
        if normalized_line == PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV:
            rewritten_lines.append(f"// {PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV}")
            continue
        if normalized_line == PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV:
            rewritten_lines.append(f"// {PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV}")
            continue
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(compile_file, rewritten_lines)
    return compile_file


def find_module_prefix(rtl_dir: Path) -> str:
    """Infer the module prefix from a module name containing DWC_pcie_ctl."""
    candidate_files = sorted(rtl_dir.rglob(f"*{DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN}.sv"))
    module_pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*module\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\b")

    for candidate_file in candidate_files:
        for line in read_file_lines(candidate_file):
            match = module_pattern.match(line)
            if not match:
                continue
            module_name = match.group(1)
            if DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN not in module_name:
                continue
            raw_prefix = module_name.replace(DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN, "", 1)
            return raw_prefix.rstrip("_")

    raise FileNotFoundError(f"unable to locate a module declaration containing {DWC_PCIE_CTL_PATTERN} under {rtl_dir}")


def rewrite_pcie_iip_device_file(rtl_dir: Path, module_prefix: str) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv with generated module names."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    module_name_prefix = build_module_prefix(module_prefix)
    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(device_file):
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^.*pcie_iip_rams", f"{module_name_prefix}pcie_ram", original_line)
        updated_line = updated_line.replace("`SNPS_PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_MODULE", f"{module_name_prefix}pcie_ctrl")
        updated_line = updated_line.replace(
            "SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
        )
        updated_line = updated_line.replace("(phy_cfg_status)", "('0)")
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(device_file, rewritten_lines)
    return device_file


def _find_phy_block_bounds(lines: list[str]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Find start and end line indices for PHY block section."""
    start_idx = None
    end_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        if start_idx is None and "PHY block instantiation" in line:
            start_idx = idx
        if "include the PHY specific instance code" in line:
            end_idx = idx
    
    if start_idx is None or end_idx is None:
        raise ValueError("unable to locate PHY extraction markers")
    if end_idx < start_idx:
        raise ValueError("invalid PHY extraction marker range")
    
    return start_idx, end_idx


def _extract_and_cut_phy_block(lines: list[str], start_idx: int, end_idx: int) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Extract PHY block and return extracted lines and remaining lines."""
    extract_start = max(0, start_idx - 1)
    extract_end = min(len(lines) - 1, end_idx + 2)
    extracted = list(lines[extract_start : extract_end + 1])
    retained = lines[:extract_start] + lines[extract_end + 1 :]
    return extracted, retained


def _transform_phy_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Apply transformations to PHY block lines."""
    # Replace semicolons with commas
    rewritten = [line.replace(";", ",") for line in lines]
    
    # Cut at PHY_VPT_NUM
    cutoff_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(rewritten):
        if "PHY_VPT_NUM" in line:
            cutoff_idx = idx
            break
    if cutoff_idx is not None:
        rewritten = rewritten[:cutoff_idx]
    
    # Apply wire direction swaps for specific signals
    final_lines = []
    for line in rewritten:
        if any(sig in line for sig in ["pclkx2", "cfg_phy_control", "phy_cfg_status"]):
            continue
        if "pclk" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "input", line)
        if "phy_rst_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "output", line)
        if "phy_perst_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "output", line)
        if "phy_ref_clk_req_n" in line:
            line = re.sub(r"\bwire\b", "input", line)
        if "mac_phy" in line:
            line = line.replace("wire", "output")
        if "phy_mac" in line:
            line = line.replace("wire", "input")
        final_lines.append(line)
    
    return final_lines


def _clean_port_list(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Clean port list formatting."""
    # Remove leading commas and consolidate
    cleaned = []
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            cleaned.append(line)
            continue
        content = re.sub(r"^\s*,\s*", "", line)
        cleaned.append(content)
    
    # Remove trailing comma from last non-empty line
    last_idx = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(cleaned):
        if line.strip():
            last_idx = idx
    if last_idx is not None:
        cleaned[last_idx] = re.sub(r",\s*$", "", cleaned[last_idx])
    
    # Add leading comma line
    first_nonempty = next((line for line in cleaned if line.strip()), None)
    if first_nonempty is not None:
        indent = first_nonempty[: len(first_nonempty) - len(first_nonempty.lstrip())]
        cleaned = [f"{indent},"] + cleaned
    
    return cleaned


def _merge_phy_into_module(retained_lines: list[str], phy_lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Merge PHY port lines into module port list."""
    module_start = None
    port_list_end = None
    for idx, line in enumerate(retained_lines):
        if module_start is None and re.search(r"\bmodule\b", line):
            module_start = idx
        if module_start is not None and line.strip() == ");":
            port_list_end = idx
            break
    
    if module_start is None or port_list_end is None:
        raise ValueError("unable to locate module port list")
    
    # Remove RF signal ports
    remove_pattern = re.compile(r"\b(rxp|rxn|txp|txn|rxpresent|refclk_p|refclk_n)\b")
    port_lines = retained_lines[module_start + 1 : port_list_end]
    filtered_ports = [line for line in port_lines if not remove_pattern.search(line)]
    
    merged = (
        retained_lines[: module_start + 1]
        + filtered_ports
        + phy_lines
        + retained_lines[port_list_end:]
    )
    return merged


def extract_phy_block_from_device_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Extract and rewrite the PHY block section from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    output_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_PHY_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    lines = read_file_lines(device_file)
    
    # Find and extract PHY block
    start_idx, end_idx = _find_phy_block_bounds(lines)
    extracted_lines, retained_lines = _extract_and_cut_phy_block(lines, start_idx, end_idx)
    
    # Transform and clean PHY lines
    phy_lines = _transform_phy_lines(extracted_lines)
    phy_lines = _clean_port_list(phy_lines)
    
    # Merge back into module port list
    merged_lines = _merge_phy_into_module(retained_lines, phy_lines)
    
    # Write output files
    write_file_lines(device_file, merged_lines)
    write_file_lines(output_file, phy_lines)
    return output_file


def rewrite_pcie_iip_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, module_prefix: str) -> Path | None:
    """Rewrite rtl/examples/pcie_iip_subsystem.sv with prefixed module macros."""
    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    module_name_prefix = build_module_prefix(module_prefix)
    rewritten_lines = []
    for original_line in read_file_lines(subsystem_file):
        updated_line = original_line.replace(
            "`SNPS_PCIE_IIP_SUBSYS_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}pcie_ctrl",
        )
        updated_line = updated_line.replace(
            "SNPS_PCIE_CTL_MODULE",
            f"{module_name_prefix}SNPS_PCIE_CTL_MODULE",
        )
        rewritten_lines.append(updated_line)

    write_file_lines(subsystem_file, rewritten_lines)
    return subsystem_file


def extract_pcie_ram_port_from_rams_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> str | None:
    """Extract and transform input/output port declarations from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_rams.sv."""
    rams_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV
    if not rams_file.is_file():
        return None

    transformed_lines: list[str] = []
    for line in read_file_lines(rams_file):
        if not re.match(r"^\s*(input|output)\b", line):
            continue
        if re.match(r"^\s*input\b.*clk", line):
            continue
        updated_line = re.sub(r"^(\s*)(input|output)\b", r"\1wire", line)
        updated_line = re.sub(r",\s*$", "", updated_line.rstrip())
        if not updated_line.endswith(";"):
            updated_line += ";"
        transformed_lines.append(updated_line)

    if not transformed_lines:
        return None
    return "\n".join(transformed_lines)


def append_pcie_ram_port_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, pcie_ram_port: str | None) -> Path | None:
    """Append extracted pcie_ram_port block after the first ');' in subsystem file."""
    if not pcie_ram_port:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(subsystem_file)
    if pcie_ram_port in text:
        return subsystem_file

    close_ports_match = re.search(r"^\s*\);\s*$", text, re.MULTILINE)
    if not close_ports_match:
        return None

    insert_pos = close_ports_match.end()
    if text[insert_pos:insert_pos + 2] == "\r\n":
        insert_pos += 2
    elif text[insert_pos:insert_pos + 1] == "\n":
        insert_pos += 1

    new_text = text[:insert_pos] + pcie_ram_port.rstrip("\n") + "\n" + text[insert_pos:]
    write_file_text(subsystem_file, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return subsystem_file


def extract_signal_names_from_pcie_ram_port(pcie_ram_port: str | None) -> list[str]:
    """Extract signal names from transformed pcie_ram_port declarations."""
    if not pcie_ram_port:
        return []

    signal_names: list[str] = []
    for line in pcie_ram_port.splitlines():
        match = re.match(r"^\s*(?:wire|input|output)\b(?:\s+\[[^\]]+\])?\s+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)\s*;", line)
        if match:
            signal_names.append(match.group(1))
    return signal_names


def delete_pcie_ram_signal_lines_from_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, signal_names: list[str]) -> Path | None:
    """Delete lines containing any pcie ram signal name from subsystem file."""
    if not signal_names:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    patterns = [re.compile(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\b") for name in signal_names]
    original_lines = read_file_lines(subsystem_file)
    kept_lines = [line for line in original_lines if not any(pattern.search(line) for pattern in patterns)]
    if kept_lines == original_lines:
        return subsystem_file

    write_file_lines(subsystem_file, kept_lines)
    return subsystem_file


def extract_pcie_ram_inst_from_device_file(rtl_dir: Path) -> str | None:
    """Extract external_rams instance block from rtl/examples/pcie_iip_device.sv."""
    device_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_DEVICE_SV
    if not device_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(device_file)
    # Match by instance name `external_rams` so module type can be prefixed/renamed.
    match = re.search(
        r"(^\s*[`A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_$`]*\s*(?:#\s*\([\s\S]*?\)\s*)?)(external_rams)(\s*\([\s\S]*?\)\s*;)",
        text,
        re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if not match:
        return None
    inst_block = f"{match.group(1)}u_pcie_ram{match.group(3)}"
    return inst_block.rstrip()


def append_pcie_ram_inst_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir: Path, pcie_ram_inst: str | None) -> Path | None:
    """Append extracted pcie_ram_inst block before endmodule in subsystem file."""
    if not pcie_ram_inst:
        return None

    subsystem_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_SUBSYSTEM_SV
    if not subsystem_file.is_file():
        return None

    text = read_file_text(subsystem_file)
    if pcie_ram_inst in text:
        return subsystem_file

    endmodule_match = re.search(r"^\s*endmodule\b", text, re.MULTILINE)
    if not endmodule_match:
        return None

    insert_pos = endmodule_match.start()
    prefix = text[:insert_pos].rstrip("\n")
    suffix = text[insert_pos:]
    new_text = f"{prefix}\n{pcie_ram_inst}\n{suffix}"
    write_file_text(subsystem_file, new_text.rstrip("\n"))
    return subsystem_file


def write_rtl_flist(rtl_dir: Path, include_scratch: bool) -> Path:
    """Write rtl/flist.f using the required line-by-line layout."""
    flist_file = rtl_dir / FLIST_F
    lines = [
        f"+incdir+{SRC_DIR}",
        f"-F {SRC_DIR}/{DWC_PCIE_CTL_LST}",
        f"-F {MEM_DIR}/{FLIST_F}",
        f"-F {EXAMPLES_DIR}/{COMPILE_F}",
    ]
    if include_scratch:
        lines.insert(3, DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNPREFIX_SVH)
        lines.append(DWC_PCIE_CTL_UNDEF_SVH)
    write_file_lines(flist_file, lines)
    return flist_file


def validate_ramgen_outputs(result: dict) -> None:
    """Ensure ramgen returned the expected output files."""
    expected_paths = [
        result.get("excel_path"),
        result.get("raminfo_csv_path"),
        result.get("output_sv_path"),
        result.get("flist_path"),
        result.get("tb_flist_path"),
        result.get("makefile_path"),
    ]
    missing = [path for path in expected_paths if not path or not Path(path).exists()]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError("ramgen completed but expected outputs are missing: {}".format(", ".join(missing)))


def run() -> dict:
    """Create rtl workspace content and run ramgen."""
    total_steps = 8

    def log_step(step_no: int, message: str) -> None:
        print("[{}/{}] {} ... ".format(step_no, total_steps, message), end="", flush=True)

    def log_ok() -> None:
        print("OK", flush=True)

    log_step(1, "validate inputs")
    paths = build_paths()
    project_root = paths["project_root"]
    rtl_dir = paths["rtl_dir"]
    mem_dir = paths["mem_dir"]
    default_sv_file = paths["default_sv_file"]
    rtl_sv_file = rtl_dir / EXAMPLES_DIR / PCIE_IIP_RAMS_SV

    ensure_source_dirs(project_root, ("examples", "src"))
    if not default_sv_file.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing input SV file: {default_sv_file}")
    log_ok()

    log_step(2, "prepare rtl workspace")
    rtl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    mem_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_ok()

    log_step(3, "copy examples and src")
    copied_dirs = {}
    for source_name in ("examples", "src"):
        copied_dirs[source_name] = str(copy_tree_into_rtl(project_root, rtl_dir, source_name))

    if not rtl_sv_file.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing copied input SV file: {rtl_sv_file}")
    log_ok()

    log_step(4, "detect module prefix")
    module_prefix = find_module_prefix(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    log_step(5, "copy scratch if needed")
    copied_scratch = False
    rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file = None
    rewritten_cdm_file = None
    rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file = None
    if module_prefix:
        ensure_source_dirs(project_root, ("scratch",))
        copied_dirs["scratch"] = str(copy_scratch_svh_into_rtl(project_root, rtl_dir))
        copied_scratch = True
        rewritten_cdm_pl_reg_file = rewrite_cdm_pl_reg_file(rtl_dir)
        rewritten_cdm_file = rewrite_cdm_file(rtl_dir)
        rewritten_dwc_pcie_core_file = rewrite_dwc_pcie_core_file(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    log_step(6, "rewrite rtl files")
    rewritten_list_file = rewrite_dwc_pcie_ctl_list(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_compile_file = rewrite_examples_compile_file(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_device_file = rewrite_pcie_iip_device_file(rtl_dir, module_prefix)
    pcie_ram_port = extract_pcie_ram_port_from_rams_file(rtl_dir)
    pcie_ram_inst = extract_pcie_ram_inst_from_device_file(rtl_dir)
    extracted_phy_block_file = extract_phy_block_from_device_file(rtl_dir)
    rewritten_subsystem_file = rewrite_pcie_iip_subsystem_file(rtl_dir, module_prefix)
    pcie_ram_signal_names = extract_signal_names_from_pcie_ram_port(pcie_ram_port)

    log_ok()

    log_step(7, "run ramgen and generate flist")
    ramgen_result = ramgen(
        sv_file=str(rtl_sv_file),
        output_dir=str(mem_dir),
        module_prefix=module_prefix,
        verbose=False,
    )
    validate_ramgen_outputs(ramgen_result)
    rtl_flist_file = write_rtl_flist(rtl_dir, include_scratch=copied_scratch)
    log_ok()

    log_step(8, "append CDM signals and pins")

    rewrite_dwc_pcie_core_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_dwc_pcie_ctl_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_device_file(rtl_dir)
    append_cdm_to_subsystem_file(rtl_dir)
    log_ok()

    return {
        "project_root": str(project_root),
        "rtl_dir": str(rtl_dir),
        "mem_dir": str(mem_dir),

        "rtl_flist_file": str(rtl_flist_file),
        "ramgen": ramgen_result,
    }


def main() -> int:

    module_prefix = result["module_prefix"] if result["module_prefix"] else "(none)"
    print(f"✓ Detected module prefix: {module_prefix}")
    print(f"✓ Generated flist: {result['rtl_flist_file']}")
    
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
